notes: Bundled startup defaults from InterfaceATF2_DR, op-base MagnetLibrary, prog_beta_calc and Turn1024; no per-user filesystem paths or sibling checkout required at runtime.

Mapping flags enable the established source convention; they do not assert a live hardware commissioning test. No EPICS reads or writes at initialization. Missing PVs fail on the relevant measurement.
COD retains the existing interface order MB1R..MB98R except 20 and 75. DR:monitors uses 10 values per slot, raw position um. No BPM is relabelled to fit the old lattice.
MB97R/MB98R geometry is unavailable in the bundled lattice. Their positions remain null; COD plots use BPM index, never invented s coordinates.
TBT uses the legacy bpm01..96 -> MB1R..MB96R order separately from COD. Nominal TBT s values come from the audited twiss file. This is the existing source mapping, not a new channel wiring survey.

Correctors follow the existing interface sequence (not an invented contiguous ZH/ZV range). SD/SF each have 34 supplies per InterfaceATF2_DR. Supply parameter.A is lower and parameter.B upper; correctors additionally limited to +/-5 A.
Q-modulation uses MagnetLibrary currentWrite/currentRead and existing mag_ki_main trim calibration; main current comes from internalCurrentWrite as in prog_beta_calc. QM7R.1 uses QM7AR.

RF changes use the existing linked DeltaFRamp controller; frequency readback is MHz, preset labels kHz. RF settle 5 s, frequency tolerance 100 Hz, timeout 30 s and quad settle 5 s are adjustable SOFTWARE DEFAULTS, not measured machine response times.
No dedicated TBT completion PV exists. Timestamp/content checks retain same_shot_verified=false; no false freshness guarantee.

Horizontal dispersion target and live phase/SR transport calibration remain explicit measurement-specific inputs; their absence does not prevent initialization, COD, vertical dispersion, or Q modulation.
